attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The PR removes TryAddEnumerable duplicate-registration guards across many core startup paths (Mvc, DisplayManagement, RazorPages, Documents, auth providers) and replaces them with plain Add*, which is broad and touches foundational registration behavior used by every module/tenant, risking duplicate service instances (e.g., duplicate IApplicationModelProvider, IStartupFilter, options configurators) if any Startup.ConfigureServices path is ever invoked more than once for the same collection."}
